We aim to process all refund requests within 2 business days. Refunds are issued to the original payment method. Depending on your bank or card issuer, it may take 5–10 business days for the funds to appear.

## License Revocation

Upon issuing a refund, your license key will be deactivated and you must uninstall LinkFlick from all your devices. Continued use of the App after a refund has been issued is not permitted under our Terms of Service.

## Purchases via Third Parties

If you purchased LinkFlick through a third-party platform (e.g., a bundle or reseller), please contact that platform directly for refund assistance, as we are unable to process refunds for purchases not made directly through linkflick.com.

# Refund Policy

Effective date: March 16, 2026

14-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied with LinkFlick for any reason, contact us within 14 days of purchase and we'll issue a full refund — no questions asked.

## Eligibility

You are eligible for a full refund if:

 Your refund request is submitted within 14 days of your original purchase date.
 Your license has not been previously refunded.

Refund requests submitted after the 14-day window are evaluated on a case-by-case basis and are not guaranteed.

results.content:
Beyond branding, Short.io also offers built-in QR code generation with every link. That means you can create scannable assets for print, product packaging, or in-person events without needing another tool. And if your team is collaborating across functions or departments, Short.io’s workspace feature allows for shared folders, roles, and link management at scale.

In short, if you want to pair link shortening with visual consistency and cross-team collaboration, Short.io delivers flexibility without complexity. It’s a great option for marketers who value both branding and ease of use.

## What to consider when choosing a Rebrandly alternative [...] ### Privacy and data compliance

With growing scrutiny around data sharing and user consent, privacy can’t be an afterthought. The right Rebrandly alternative should offer transparency and control over how link data is collected, stored, and used.

For teams with strict requirements, open source platforms may offer more visibility and self-hosting options. These solutions are especially useful in regulated industries or internal use cases where full control is paramount.

You’ll also want to ensure the platform supports granular permissions so only approved users can access or edit key assets. This improves both compliance and workflow security—reducing the risk of errors or leaks. [...] ## What to consider when choosing a Rebrandly alternative

Before switching from Rebrandly to another provider, it’s essential to weigh your business goals against the core capabilities of each tool. Whether you’re managing thousands of links or launching your first campaign, here are three key dimensions to evaluate:

### Scalability and governance

As your team grows and campaigns expand, your link management needs will quickly outpace basic tools. A scalable link management platform should allow for advanced organization, role-based access, and centralized control, so your marketing, product, and ops teams can collaborate without chaos.
